assumptions.flow_allocation: conservative branch split proportional to effective radius cubed; unary segments carry parent flow
assumptions.wss_radius_regularisation: effective radius is also floored by the Murray-consistent radius implied by local flow fraction, preventing unresolved unary contractions from creating artificial WSS spikes
assumptions.wss_radius_floor_scope: post-processing only; raw geometry remains unchanged
assumptions.habr_interpretation: post-resection HA flow is an illustrative buffered response, not a calibrated patient measurement

literature_anchor_note: Published liver-flow studies commonly place HA near 20-25% of total afferent liver inflow and describe reciprocal HA recruitment after portal-flow reduction; the WSS values here remain model-derived because no subject-specific hepatic-artery WSS measurement is imposed.
